To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the academic labor process in public research universities is being restructured to conform to a new model of academic capitalism.
the academic profession is in transition.
academic labor has been transformed from a profession to a market, and that the university is being restructured from an institution of public good to a business enterprise.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the political economy is restructuring the university and how faculty and administrators respond to this reorganization.
how faculty are being drawn into the market and how the market is shaping their work.
how the university as an institution is changing and how the work of faculty and students is being reorganized in the context of these changes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Academic Capitalism is a book that should be read by anyone interested in the future of higher education.
academic capitalism is a system of academic work that is organized to maximize the production of intellectual commodities.
academic capitalism has become the dominant mode of organizing academic work.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the university is being transformed into a knowledge enterprise that is more closely tied to the market.
academic capitalism is the new paradigm in higher education.

academic capitalism is the result of a confluence of forces: the globalization of the political and economic order and the resulting changes in the structure of the economy; changes in the nature of knowledge and its production; and the changing relationship between the university and the state, particularly the federal government.

faculty have been transformed from public intellectuals to entrepreneurial academics who are increasingly responsible for generating their own income, and who are expected to compete in the global market for students and research dollars.
the university is a site for the production of knowledge and the production of labor.
